020@HistoryLogProps(
021    opCode = 447,
022    displayName = "CGM Stop Session (G7)",
023    internalName = "LID_CGM_STOP_SESSION_G7"
024)
025public class CgmStopSessionG7HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
026
027    private long currentTransmitterTime;
028    private long sessionStartTime;
029    private long sessionStopTime;
030    private int stopSessionCode;
031    private int sessionStopReason;
032    private int sessionDuration;
033
034    public CgmStopSessionG7HistoryLog() {}
035    public CgmStopSessionG7HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, long sessionStopTime, int stopSessionCode, int sessionStopReason, int sessionDuration) {
036        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
037        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, currentTransmitterTime, sessionStartTime, sessionStopTime, stopSessionCode, sessionStopReason, sessionDuration);
038        this.currentTransmitterTime = currentTransmitterTime;
039        this.sessionStartTime = sessionStartTime;
040        this.sessionStopTime = sessionStopTime;
041        this.stopSessionCode = stopSessionCode;
042        this.sessionStopReason = sessionStopReason;
043        this.sessionDuration = sessionDuration;
044
045    }
046
047    public CgmStopSessionG7HistoryLog(long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, long sessionStopTime, int stopSessionCode, int sessionStopReason, int sessionDuration) {
048        this(0, 0, currentTransmitterTime, sessionStartTime, sessionStopTime, stopSessionCode, sessionStopReason, sessionDuration);
049    }
050
051    public int typeId() {
052        return 447;
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * <table border="1">
057     * <caption>Parsed fields for CgmStopSessionG7HistoryLog:</caption>
058     * <tr><td><code>currentTransmitterTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
059     * <tr><td><code>sessionStartTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
060     * <tr><td><code>sessionStopTime</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
061     * <tr><td><code>sessionDuration</code></td><td><code>raw[22] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
062     * <tr><td><code>sessionStopReason</code></td><td><code>raw[23] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
063     * <tr><td><code>stopSessionCode</code></td><td><code>raw[24] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
064     * </table>
065     */
066    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
067        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
068        this.cargo = raw;
069        parseBase(raw);
070        this.currentTransmitterTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
071        this.sessionStartTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
072        this.sessionStopTime = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
073        // Tandem's cloud export stores bytes 22-25 as one byte-reversed word, so its offsets 15/14/13 are BLE bytes 22/23/24.
074        this.sessionDuration = raw[22] & 0xFF;
075        this.sessionStopReason = raw[23] & 0xFF;
076        this.stopSessionCode = raw[24] & 0xFF;
077
078    }
079
080    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long currentTransmitterTime, long sessionStartTime, long sessionStopTime, int stopSessionCode, int sessionStopReason, int sessionDuration) {
081        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
082            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(447, 0), // 447 = 0x01BF
083            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
084            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
085            Bytes.toUint32(currentTransmitterTime),
086            Bytes.toUint32(sessionStartTime),
087            Bytes.toUint32(sessionStopTime),
088            new byte[]{ (byte) sessionDuration },
089            new byte[]{ (byte) sessionStopReason },
090            new byte[]{ (byte) stopSessionCode }));
091    }
092

099    }
100

104
105    public int getStopSessionCode() {

108
109    public int getSessionStopReason() {

111    }
112
113    public int getSessionDuration() {

115    }
